crashed_configs: c1000_w* (all-DP4A queue): illegal memory access — grouped DP4A path bug when the IMMA queue is empty (or DP4A all-tiles edge); NOT the fast config. The fast config is c0 (all-IMMA).
verdict: crossover=0 (all-IMMA, block_m=8 tiles) is 3.0x faster than the c3_w8 baseline at K56 golden: 12.94 vs 39.15 ms/layer (0.557 vs 1.683 s/block). The crossover=3 split was tuned at K8-mid where tiny-M DP4A dominates; at K56 (mean M=3.9) all-IMMA wins. Full 43-layer block bench + exactness parity verification pending in artifacts/moe_breakthrough.json.

source_analysis.weight_load_pattern: per-warp 16B strided segments (g*K + 4t), 8 rows x 16B per 32-lane transaction -> ~50-62% DRAM sector efficiency
source_analysis.reduction: __syncthreads() per K-round in shared-memory K-split reduction
source_analysis.proposed_surgery: float4 vectorized weight loads; gu n-tile 16->64 / down 32->64 (4x fewer blocks, 4x weight reuse per block, wider coalesced segments); warp-shuffle reduction instead of smem round-trip
source_analysis.bug_found: crossover=1000 (all-IMMA) triggers illegal memory access in grouped path when DP4A queue empty

config_semantics.crossover=N: counts <= N -> DP4A queue (block_m=1 tiles); counts > N -> IMMA queue (block_m=8 tiles)
config_semantics.c1000: all experts DP4A (crashes; also slow per c8 trend)
